items.title: New Trend Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Time to step up your game in the world of fashion! Walk the maps of your favorite gamemodes and be the best in style! From dark outfits to colorful and cute styles, the is everything for everyone! So what are you waiting for, be the star with these trendy skins!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Modern Life
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Summertime is here! The sun is shining and the city is bustling with life! With this skin pack, you are sure to experience modern life with style! Go party with your friends or sit home and watch your favorite anime, you will always be looking at your best with these trendy and cute teen skins!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Color Buddies
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Ever wanted to rock matching outfits with your friends? Want no more! With these Color Buddies skins, you and your friend will be looking at your best while looking similar! Pick your favorite color and go have fun on your favorite server!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Legendary Friends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Stop! Are you interested in fashion and colorful outfits? Well, this might be for you! No matter what colors or styles you like, this pack offers something for everyone! Pick your favorite skin and show off to your friends!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Cute Idols
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Join up with the cute idols group and dominate the fashion world! Hang out with your best friends in style or play solo and know that you are rocking the Minecraft world in style! From colorful outfits to dark and gloomy skins, there is something for everyone in this skin pack!

- 12 cool skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Teen Gamers
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Grab your gear, grab a drink, and get ready for a night of gaming with your friends! These teens know how to level up their skills! Be on your AAA game with these skins at your back, and know that your friends will be at your side!

items.title: Mob Merch
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs just bought some brand new clothes and are looking sharp! From comfy hoodies to brand new T-shirts, they're excited to show off their new merch!

- 8 skins!

This set contains the following designs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Pig
- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Spider
- Slime
- Bee

items.title: Mob Streamers
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are pros at gaming and are now some of the world's top streamers! Look at that viewer count climb!

- 8 skins!
- Play as your favorite mob, wearing brand new headsets and cool hoodies too!

items.title: Royal School
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These princes and princesses have a lot to learn before they can rule an empire! Luckily they're enrolled in the most prestigious boarding school around!

- 8 skins!
- Golden crowns, fancy school uniforms, pick the design that suits you best!

items.title: Glitched Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Ooph, these mobs are glitching! From missing textures and corrupted files to a strange creeper-bee hybrid, everything has bugged out!

- 8 glitched skins!
- Different broken textures that are sure to confuse everyone!

items.title: Virtual Creepers
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These creepers have levelled up and are ready to take on anything with their brand new armor!

- 8 skins!
- Different Creeper colors so you can pick the perfect one to suit you!

items.title: Virtual Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are equipped with the latest in cybernetic gear and are ready to explore the virtual world! From colorful armor to high-tech helmets, they're ready for anything!

- 8 skins!


This set contains the following designs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Spider
- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Pig
- Slime
- Bee

items.title: Mob Drip
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are wearing the latest in fashion trends! With so many different outfits, you can pick the perfect one that suits you!

- 8 skins!
- With brand new sneakers, and hoodies fresh from the rack, you'll stand out from any crowd!

Which mob is your favorite?

items.title: Black and White Style
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These skins have lost all color and are totally black and white! Whether you want to sport the manga look or just want to stand out from all the other skins, you can find a design that suits you!

- 8 skins!
- Branded hoodies, new sneakers, and more!

items.title: Pirate Kraken Island
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: Hello, sailor! Have fun exploring this immense island, its caves, mystical places and a vast ocean that surrounds it, but be careful with a dangerous kraken nearby! What are you waiting for to explore this amazing pirate island? Arrr!

items.title: Ore Blocks
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Ores, ores, ores! Who doesn’t like them? Isn’t that the reason we go mining, after all?
Play the role of your favourite one and enjoy all its value, as a derp ore block.

+ 8 exclusive ores you can choose from!
+ Live the life of your dream ore as a cute derp!

items.title: Team Bunnies
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
The cutest bunny team has arrived with delicious and colorful eggs! 
Have fun with these 9 HD skins and spread the spring vibes everywhere!

- Colorful, detailed, funny and cool!
- 9 unique HD skins!

items.title: Freedom Punks
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Meet these rebellious teens and go out like a superstar! Listen to loud rock, speed up down the hill on your cool motorbike and try to win the race. Everyone is participating so why wouldn't you? Did you hear about the latest rumors in town? The prize is expensive. Give yourself a chance!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Friends in Suits
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Wear the crown like the true king or queen you are! Suit up and go to the most luxurious party in town. Have a great time among your friends and become the soul of the party. Everyone is friendly here and ready to meet you, how about you?

+ 2 free skins
+ 14 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Summer Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Embrace the heat of the sun and feel the authentic vibes of the summer among these stylish squad! Explore all the beaches, taste the sweet cocktails out there, enjoy the fun beach games, and win many trophies. Try fun activities, such as exploring the ocean or even sailing a boat; it's your choice!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Freedom Heroes
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Whether you're a hero or a simple citizen, the city has enough space for everyone! Protect the community and join different squads that are trying to reach the top. You are unique in your way, so come and get to know your extraordinary power! You are the bringer of the peace!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Pool Party
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Jump into the pool and test the waters! Feel the fresh cold water surrounding you and wear the latest sunglasses released. What do you prefer, the beach or the pool? Join both parties and see what is best for you. We heard some great rappers are coming to the pool party, don't miss this one-time chance!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Pretty in Blue
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Fill your life with this royal color and start a new journey among the best of friends. Get ready to try new fashion styles using a variety of blue shades! Get to know the importance of clothes shape and get used to this new trend. Fill your wardrobe with blue!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Demons: Latest Trend
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Let your demon-side show! Become scary and wear the freshest trends in town! Enjoy your free time in the busy city and watch out for the party breakers. Become the most excellent demon while wearing your brand new clothes and feel the vibe!

+ 2 free skin
+ 14 demon-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary
